title: L1A Note Card
description: One printable, flippable note card. Cards are a first-class product, not an export (docs/master-plan.md 6). A card is generated from its parent concept - concept.card_data holds the structured content, this record holds the rendered two sides plus everything the print layout needs. Layout is fixed by brand/print.css: L1A stamp top-left, tier color bar down the left edge, type label top-right, footer line across the bottom.

id.description: Card ID: the parent concept ID plus -Cnn, e.g. EMT-02-03-04-C01.

concept_id.description: Parent concept. The card's content is generated from that concept's key_points and card_data so the deck can never drift from the lesson.

type.description: One of the seven card types. Must be listed in the parent concept's cards[], and the matching concept.card_data sub-object should exist for every type except 'concept'.

front.description: The prompt side. Kept short enough to read at a glance on a 3x5.

title.description: The card's headline - the one idea, the drug name, the skill name.

summary.description: One-sentence framing under the title. Optional; a bare title front is fine for recall drilling.

back.description: The answer side. For structured types the renderer builds this from concept.card_data; body is the prose fallback and the whole of a concept card.

why_it_matters.description: The one-line 'why this is on the card' that every concept card carries.

high_yield.description: Known exam favorite. Prints the Signal Yellow high-yield flag. Normally inherited from the parent concept.

number.description: Position within its curated deck, for ordering a printed set and putting it back in order after a shuffle.

print_size.description: Card stock size. 3x5 in is the locked primary (decisions.md); 4x6 and A6 are optional layouts. The print engine tiles whichever is chosen onto Letter or A4 with cut guides and duplex-aligned backs.

footer.description: The printed footer line and the left-edge color bar. Renders as: Ladder One Academy - Rung N - Tier - Module N Name. In black and white the tier bar becomes a pattern rather than a color.

rung.description: Rung number: 1 EMT, 2 Fire, 3 Paramedic. Also selects the color bar - star white, ember, line blue.

media.description: Media id from the parent concept's media[] to print on the card - a diagram or strip. Must be print_safe.

side.description: Which side the media sits on.

allOf.description: Naming a side without media is meaningless.
